results.rationale: Consistency: people, grass and rope grid remain, but the top-middle O is changed to X and existing center/right tiles are rotated or shifted. Instruction: a new bottom-middle X forms a central column only because an opponent's O was also replaced; the legal winning addition should be top-left for the existing diagonal. Knowledge: changing an occupied opponent square and adding another mark violate the one-move game logic. Quality: the physical tiles, readable symbols and outdoor scene are coherent without noticeable artifacts.

Consistency: device and cuff layout remain, but the pulse changes from 70 to 05 and cuff surface/printed labels are altered. Instruction: pressure values become a clear 142/90. Knowledge: 142 exceeds the supplied systolic threshold of 130 and 90 exceeds the diastolic threshold of 80. Quality: readable pressure digits and coherent housing, but the pulse reading 05 is semantically anomalous and small unit text is malformed.
